comment: Coral City: Neon Tide screenshot plan. Each entry renders the live game in headless Chrome at 1280x800 against serve.ts; ?shot= scenes are deterministic (see Shots.apply in game/src/shots.js) and seed=1 fixes the city. Adding &test=1 to any scene also writes an {fps, errors} report into the page for the pre-flight check.

shots.scene: Title screen over the Palmetto pier at dusk
Night drive down the Neon Strip, HUD and minimap lit
On foot at the casino door as the first job's dialog opens
Four-star police chase with a roadblock ahead, wanted stars and minimap lit
